 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 23.03.2023 CRL.M.A. 6631/2023 (Exemption)
1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2.
The application is disposed of accordingly.
W.P.(CRL) 715/2023 & CRL.M.A. 6630/2023 (Interim Protection)

3. The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR No. 09/2023, under Sections 420/406/120B of the IPC, registered at P.S. EOW.
4.
Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioners submits that the present FIR with respect to the present petitioners is in nature of a second FIR on the same set of facts.
It is submitted that the previous FIR No. 174/2018 with respect to the same transaction had already been registered.
The complainants in the present FIR had given their complaints with respect to the present transaction in the said earlier FIR No. 174/2018.
It is submitted that the chargesheet in the said FIR had been filed, and therefore, the present FIR could not have been registered.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioners further submits that petitioner no. 2 had been inducted in the company as an independent director in 25.05.2017 and had resigned on 12.12.2019.
It is pointed out that the transaction with respect to the present FIR relates to a period prior to 2017.

It is further pointed out that the role of petitioner no. 2 was investigated in earlier FIR No. 174/2018 and was exonerated therein.
6.
Issue notice.
7. Learned ASC for the State and learned counsel for respondents no. 4 & 5 accept notice.

8. Issue notice to respondents no. 2, 3, 6, 7, 8 and 9 through all permissible modes, including electronic mail, if any, returnable on 12.05.2023.
9.
In the meantime, on the applicant joining the investigation as and when directed by the Investigating Officer, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner till the next date of hearing.
10. Order to be uploaded on the website of this Court forthwith.
AMIT SHARMA, J MARCH 23, 2023/
